label: GitHub access
think: Is the account the right one? The username is in the card; open the profile and check it is the person's Workspace account.
Which permission? Write lets them push; nobody but you needs Admin.
Only a repository admin can do it: if that is only you, it is yours, and it takes under a minute.
Done means invited: they still have to accept, and their conductor confirms a push works.
